title: 第25章 通天石猿第26章 我又不是你爹
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 莫凡抬头看去，四周的淤泥都在移动。接着，一双又一双眼睛，在四周泛起幽蓝的寒芒。
自己这是进入鳄鱼的领地了啊！还恰好站在一只鳄鱼的头部！
“暗黑泥鳄，快走！”神秘戒指发出警告。
不需神秘戒指提醒，莫凡就已经提步要逃。
脚下的暗黑泥鳄却猛然抬头，要把莫凡甩进鳄鱼群中。
被甩到两丈多的空中，看着下面大张着的几十张血盆大口，那些大嘴巴里又长又尖利闪耀着寒光，莫凡感到头皮发麻。
同时，几十张鳄鱼的嘴巴张开，那些嘴巴里吐出的腥臭之气，以及腐肉的气息，熏得莫凡的胃一阵翻腾。
眼看着即将落入一张大嘴，莫凡施展神影步，横移两步，脱离大嘴的咬合范围，然后踏在那只暗黑泥鳄的两只大眼中间，借着一踏之力，高高跃起。
“咔！”身下响起令人牙酸的咬合声。要是被这么一咬，马上就会变成两截。
莫凡依葫芦画瓢，连续施展神影步，在暗黑泥鳄群中闪转腾挪。
暗黑泥鳄被激怒，整片沼泽里泥浆翻腾。
连续十几次跳跃后，莫凡终于跳出暗黑泥鳄的包围，向着沼泽深处奔去。
暗黑泥鳄似乎不打算离开那一片沼泽，不再追击莫凡，依次沉入沼泽的泥浆之中。而岩冰狼也不甘地低吼离去。沼泽又恢复平静。
“小子，反应能力不错。”神秘戒指难得夸奖莫凡一次。
“多谢前辈！要不是前辈帮着改进了那神影步，提升了步法的速度，恐怕我连那岩冰狼都跑不过。”莫凡很庆幸自己及时学会了神影步。
“嘿嘿，要谢我，等下次我需要的时候来点灵石就好。”
“没问题，前辈如有需要，说一声就是。”
“我想起来了，我以前有一个名字，叫始元戒。你以后也这么叫我吧。”神秘戒指道。
“好的，始元前辈。”莫凡回道。同时在心里琢磨，又是始，又是元，都有本源的意思。看来，这始元戒来头肯定大得惊人。
从沼泽前行，一路都是光秃秃、静悄悄的，没有丛林，也没有凶兽出没。
前面，出现一个小小的山头。山顶上，几块巨石搭成一个拱门，连接着一个黑黢黢的洞口。
莫凡心中哀叹，这是又闯入一个可怕凶兽的地盘里了吧。
正这么想着，那洞口走出一道巨大的身影。那道身影足有一丈高，步履沉重，每一步都踩得地面轰轰作响。
身影走出巨石拱门后，莫凡才看清，那是一只巨大的猿。
“实力至少达到化神境后期的通天石猿，小子，你要倒霉了。”始元戒沉声道。
“前辈，想想办法啊。”莫凡大为着急。
“实力相差太大，它一巴掌就能把你拍成肉末。你逃也逃不了，没什么办法可想。”始元戒很干脆的说。
“人类小子，你闯入我的地盘，找死吗？”通天石猿口吐人言，声如洪钟。
content_en:
Mo Fan looked up and saw that the mud all around was moving. Then, one pair after another, a cold blue light appeared all around.
I have entered the territory of crocodiles! He even happened to be standing on the head of a crocodile!
"Dark Mud Crocodile, move quickly!" the mysterious ring warned.
Mo Fan was already ready to escape without the reminder of the mysterious ring.
The dark mud crocodile at his feet suddenly raised its head, trying to throw Mo Fan into the crocodile group.
Being thrown more than two feet into the air, Mo Fan felt his scalp numb as he looked at the dozens of bloody mouths gaping below. Those big mouths were long, sharp and shining with cold light.
At the same time, dozens of crocodile mouths opened, and the stinking smell and smell of rotting meat exhaled from those mouths made Mo Fan's stomach churn.
Seeing that he was about to fall into a big mouth, Mo Fan used the Shadow Step, moved two steps laterally, and got out of the bite range of the big mouth, then stepped between the two big eyes of the dark mud crocodile, and jumped up high with the force of his step.
"Click!" A tooth-grinding sound sounded from beneath him. If it is bitten like this, it will immediately break into two pieces.
Mo Fan followed the gourd and used the Divine Shadow Step continuously to move around among the dark mud crocodiles.
The Dark Mud Crocodile was enraged, and the entire swamp was filled with mud.
After jumping more than a dozen times in a row, Mo Fan finally jumped out of the siege of the Dark Mud Crocodile and ran towards the depths of the swamp.
The Dark Mud Crocodile seemed to have no intention of leaving the swamp, and stopped chasing Mo Fan, sinking into the mud of the swamp one after another. The Rock Ice Wolf roared away unwillingly. The swamp was calm again.
"Boy, your reflexes are good." The mysterious ring rarely praised Mo Fan.
"Thank you, senior! If senior hadn't helped improve the Shadow Step and increased the speed of the footwork, I might not even be able to outrun the Rock Ice Wolf." Mo Fan was very glad that he learned the Shadow Step in time.
"Hey, if you want to thank me, just give me some spiritual stones when I need it next time."
"No problem, senior, if you need anything, just ask."
"I remembered, I used to have a name called Shi Yuan Ring. You can also call me that in the future." The mysterious ring said.
"Okay, Senior Shiyuan." Mo Fan replied. At the same time, I thought in my mind that it is both the beginning and the yuan, both of which have the meaning of origin. It seems that the background of this Shiyuan Ring must be astonishing.
The road ahead from the swamp is bare and quiet, with no jungle or vicious beasts.
Ahead, a small hill appeared. On the top of the mountain, several huge rocks formed an arch, connecting a dark cave entrance.
Mo Fan lamented in his heart, this must be another terrible beast's territory.
Just as he was thinking this, a huge figure walked out of the cave. The figure was a foot tall and walked heavily, making the ground roar with every step.
After the figure walked out of the huge stone arch, Mo Fan saw clearly that it was a huge ape.
"Tiantian Stone Ape whose strength has reached at least the late stage of the Divine Transformation Realm, boy, you are going to be in trouble." Shi Yuanjie said in a deep voice.
"Senior, think of a way." Mo Fan was very worried.
"The difference in strength is too big. It can slap you into mincemeat. You can't escape, there is nothing you can do." Shi Yuan Jie said simply.
"Human boy, are you seeking death for intruding into my territory?" The Tongtian Stone Ape spoke human words, with a sound like a bell.
